newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan Japan says group in talks to sell assets.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan Japan says group in talks to sell assets.

text.p: Yaohan Japan Corp said on Monday that Yaohan International Holdings Ltd (YIH) is negotiating with a Chinese partner over the sale of part of YIH's stake in a department store in Shanghai.
A Yaohan Japan official also said a unit of Yaohan Japan is in talks with Best Denki Co Ltd over the sale of retail chains which sell home electrical appliances.
Both YIH and Yaohan Japan are key members of the Yaohan group.
"YIH is negotiating with Shanghai No.1 Department Store," the Yaohan Japan official said.
He said YIH was in talks regarding the sale of a 15 percent stake in Nextage Shanghai, a joint venture with the Shanghai partner, but he added that the talks had not yet reached a conclusion.
Currently Nextage Shanghai is 36 percent owned by YIH, 19 percent by Yaohan Japan and 45 percent by the Chinese partner, Shanghai No. 1 Department Store.
Funds expected to be raised through the asset sale will be used to repay debts at Yaohan Japan, the company official said.
The official did not elaborate on details of the negotiations between the Yaohan Japan unit and Best Denki.

Japanese media reports said proceeds from the sale of electrical appliance stores would be used to finance the redemption of convertible bonds. The Yaohan Japan official did not comment on the potential use of the funds.
